feature.label: OpenJMLFeature
feature.description: This Eclipse plugin feature contains the OpenJML plug-in, which integrates JML specifications with Java code using an LSP server to communicate between the Eclipse IDE and the underlying OpenJML command-line tool and programmatic API. See materials at https://openjml.org and https://github.com/OpenJML/OpenJML for more detail.
